Class ImageMapLoader

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.data.ImageMapLoader
public class ImageMapLoader extends Object
Loads and exports simulation data from/to standard map images (Heightmaps/Biomemaps/Resource maps). Assumes Equirectangular projection (Plate Carrée). Supports: - PNG / JPEG / GeoTIFF image mapping - ESRI World File (.tfw / .wld) export invalid input: '&' import for spatial metadata alignment - Multi-channel Geology invalid input: '&' Resource mapping (Red=Metals, Green=Flora, Blue=Water)
Version:
2.2.0
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot
